newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rains seen scarce in Brazil soybean states - Somar.
newsitem.headline: Rains seen scarce in Brazil soybean states - Somar.

text.p: Rains will remain scattered in Brazil's key southern soybean states of Parana and Rio Grande do Sul until next week, said independent meteorologists Somar.
Isolated showers will fall in the south and centre-west until January 13th and 14th, when cold fronts are forecast to move across the south, bringing with them more extensive rains.
Until then, rainfall will be concentrated in the north and north-east interior and the north of Mato Grosso state.
Somar said rainfall so far this month had been below average in Rio Grande do Sul, where the lack of rains coupled with high temperatures was causing the soil to lose moisture.
But in Parana rains were average, with mostly afternoon showers.
Meanwhile the south-east and North-east interior saw above average rains while in Mato Grosso, most of the showers fell in the east of the state.
